text:
mira: FYI FinOps spotted a big mismatch between reported charge and actual spend in us-west-2 last week, looks like spot interruptions are the culprit. How do folks want interruption overhead folded into chargeback? cc @sam @jordan
sam: Ran hourly snapshots. Summary: p4d spot avg price us-west-2 $0.18/hr, eu-west-1 $0.11/hr. Measured preempt rate: us-west-2 ~14%, eu-west-1 ~5%. If you add reprovision/warmup we get effective cost per GPU-hour ~= us-west-2 $0.21, eu-west-1 $0.12.
jordan: Our billing currently uses raw spot price only. We should switch to an "effective unit cost" that includes interruption loss + on-demand fallback. Also provide 95th pct as conservative option for teams.
lee: Ops: there was AZ maintenance Tue night that spiked preempts in us-west-2. Autoscaler replaced ~14 nodes, observed ~6 model restarts (~90s each). kubectl shows eviction notices.
ops-bot: Autoscaler log snippet: 2026-03-10T14:21Z scale-up triggered (replacements requested: 14), avg replacement time 3.2m.
finance-bot: Current chargeback snapshot (7d CSV):
region,spot-hrs,ondemand-hrs,spot-spend,ondemand-spend,reported-charge
us-west-2,420,60,$75.6,$36.0,$80.0
eu-west-1,520,20,$57.2,$12.0,$60.0
Note: reported-charge only uses spot price column, no interruption adj.
alex: Suggestion: compute per-region effective_unit_cost as:
``````
effective = spot_price + P_interrupt * on_demand_price * (avg_reprovision_sec / 3600)
``````
This captures expected on-demand fallback cost due to lost work. We can expand to include cache-warm times.
mira: +1. Action plan: (1) Sam to produce daily per-region effective_unit_cost (rolling 7d) and PR to billing-schedules; (2) Jordan to emit median + 95th effective cost in forecasting and label runs that should go to Dedicated; (3) Lee to add autoscaler metric "node_reprovision_time" and a weekly interruption frequency report. Owners: sam/jordan/lee. PRs by EOD Thu.
sam: I'll generate CSV with columns: region,spot_price,P_interrupt,avg_reprovision_sec,effective_cost and open PR. Will include breakdown and example recalculation for last 30d.
jordan: Also adding flag in job metadata for "conservative_billing" so product teams can opt-in to 95th percentile pricing.
lee: I'll add dashboard panels and temp-bump reserved pool in us-west-2 (+2 GPUs for 72h) to smooth customer impact.
finance-bot: After PR merges we'll post summary deltas to #finance and run a sample recalculation for last month to show effect on chargebacks.
alex: Minor: include KV cache-warm penalty (~30-60s on big models) in next pass. I'll add a sample line to the PR.
mira: Good. Once PR merges please post a one-paragraph note in FinOps channel summarizing changes and expected delta. If we ship this week we avoid a surprise variance next billing cycle. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
